excluded_columns_and_reasons.Label: Prediction target itself.
excluded_columns_and_reasons.Cat: Alternative/finer target — only knowable once a flow is already known to be anomalous; using it as a predictor would leak the answer.
excluded_columns_and_reasons.Sub_Cat: Same leakage reason as Cat, at finer granularity.
excluded_columns_and_reasons.Flow_ID: High-cardinality identifier — risks memorization instead of learning general traffic behaviour.
excluded_columns_and_reasons.Timestamp: Raw timestamp identifier — risks memorizing specific capture windows instead of learning generalizable attack behaviour.
